input: Notarize the lease agreement before Friday

gold.taskTitle: Notarize the lease agreement before Friday
gold.taskDescription: Get the lease agreement formally notarized by a notary public before the Friday deadline.

questions.title: Which Friday is the exact deadline?
questions.description: Confirm the specific date of the Friday deadline so the timeline is clear.

questions.title: Do you already have the final signed lease document?
questions.description: Determine whether the lease agreement is fully prepared and ready for notarization.

questions.title: How many parties need to sign before the notary?
questions.description: Identify whether it is just you, or if a landlord, co-tenant, or other parties must also be present.

questions.title: Do you have a notary already in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred notary, or needs help locating one.

questions.title: Does notarization need to happen in a specific location?
questions.description: Clarify whether there is a required city, state, or venue for the notarization to take place.

questions.title: What government-issued ID will you bring for the notary?
questions.description: Confirm the user has valid identification ready, as notaries require it to verify identity.

questions.title: Are there any specific notary requirements stated in the lease?
questions.description: Check whether the lease itself specifies any particular type of notarization, seal, or jurisdiction.
